name: wabcut
description: Wabcut - open-source cross-platform non-linear video editor

audio-plugins.description: Audio plugin hosting (A.6, docs/plugins.md): the CLAP headers (free-audio/clap, MIT) and the Steinberg VST3 SDK (MIT since 3.8) for the out-of-process helper wabcut-plughost, pinned by the baseline (clap 1.2.10, VST3 SDK 3.8.1 build 84). Enabled by WABCUT_WITH_AUDIO_PLUGINS.

ai-onnx.description: Smart search: ONNX Runtime 1.24.4 from Microsoft's official release binaries (overlay port onnxruntime-prebuilt in cmake/ports; DirectML + CPU on Windows, CPU on Linux, CPU + Core ML on macOS) for the wabcut-embed helper. Enabled by WABCUT_WITH_ONNX.

ai-cloud.description: Cloud AI keys in the OS keychain: QtKeychain 0.17 (overlay port in cmake/ports, built against the app's external Qt via WABCUT_QT_DIR). Enabled by WABCUT_WITH_CLOUD_AI.

ai-local.description: Local AI: whisper.cpp transcription in the wabcut-infer helper (ggml with run-time CPU variants and the Vulkan backend). Enabled by WABCUT_WITH_LOCAL_AI; uses the overlay ports in cmake/ports.
